_about: Sources and standard lines the customer talk tracks use, so every claim says where it comes from in words a vehicle owner understands. repairTime.say is how hours are described to the customer (never 'labor guide'); repairTime.source is the reference added at the end of a talk track that quotes hours from a real labor-guide export (resources/labor_guide/*.xml); repairTime.sourceSynthetic is used for the made-up demo rows in synthetic/, which must not be attributed to a provider. laborGuide.cite is the advisor-facing name. maintenance names the schedule ({make} is filled in). confirm, approval and estimate are appended where a talk track quotes work or a price. repairTime.sourceWithMaintenance is used when a talk track quotes Mitchell 1 repair rows together with maintenance items, whose times are estimates.

repairTime.sourceWithMaintenance: (Source: Mitchell 1 repair times; maintenance times are standard estimates.)

maintenance.generic: a general maintenance schedule (not specific to this make)

confirm: We recommend a technician inspection first to confirm the cause. We will contact you with the findings and an estimate, and no work is done without your approval.
approval: These are recommendations; nothing is added without your approval.
estimate: plus parts, applicable fees and taxes
